// func xorKeyStreamVX(dst, src []byte, key *[8]uint32, nonce *[3]uint32, counter *uint32)
TEXT ·xorKeyStreamVX(SB), NOSPLIT, $0
	MOVD	dst+0(FP), R1

	MOVD	src_len+32(FP), R3

	MOVD	nonce+56(FP), R6

	MOVD	$·incRotMatrix(SB), R11
